navaid.name: Mukilteo Ferry Terminal Dolphin Light
navaid.description: On floating dolphin. HORN: 1 (5sec bl) ev 22sec. Private aid.

navaid.name: Mukilteo Lighthouse
navaid.description: White octagonal tower with red roof, attached to white square building. Lighted throughout 24 hours. HORN: 1 blast ev 30s (3s bl). HORN is activated by keying the mic 5 times on VHF-FM Channel 83A (157.175MHz). HORN will operate for 30 minutes.
